mapper.select: select user_id accountId,status,del_flag delFlag from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} for update
select user_id accountId,status,del_flag delFlag from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId}

select id applicationId,account_id accountId,status,admin_disabled adminDisabled,auth_epoch authEpoch from p_application where id=#{applicationId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='USER' for update
select id applicationId,account_id accountId,status,admin_disabled adminDisabled,auth_epoch authEpoch from p_application where id=#{applicationId} and account_id=#{accountId} and purpose='USER'
select id,account_id accountId,application_id applicationId,key_type keyType,name,scopes,status from p_access_key where id=#{id} and account_id=#{accountId} for update

select cast(id as char) keyId,name,key_type keyType,cast(application_id as char) applicationId,public_id publicId,display_suffix displaySuffix,scopes,status,created_at createdAt,last_used_at lastUsedAt from p_access_key where id=#{id} and account_id=#{accountId}

select k.id,k.account_id accountId,k.application_id applicationId,k.key_type keyType,k.secret_hash secretHash, k.hash_key_version hashKeyVersion,k.scopes,k.status,k.expires_at expiresAt,k.auth_epoch authEpoch, u.status accountStatus,u.del_flag accountDeleted,a.status applicationStatus,a.admin_disabled adminDisabled from p_access_key k join sys_user u on u.user_id=k.account_id left join p_application a on a.id=k.application_id and a.account_id=k.account_id where k.public_id=#{publicId}
select id,name from p_access_key where application_id=#{applicationId} and key_type='APPLICATION' and status='ACTIVE' for update
mapper.insert: insert into p_access_key (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,application_id,key_type,name,public_id,secret_hash,hash_key_version,display_suffix,scopes,status,auth_epoch) values (#{id},#{now},#{now},#{accountId},#{applicationId},#{type},#{name},#{publicId},#{hash},'hmac-sha256-v1',#{suffix},cast(#{scopes} as json),'ACTIVE',1)
mapper.update: update p_access_key set status=#{status},revoked_at=utc_timestamp(3),updated_at=utc_timestamp(3),auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1 where id=#{id} and status!='DELETED'
update p_access_key set last_used_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and (last_used_at is null or last_used_at < utc_timestamp(3)-interval 1 minute)
mapper.select: select request_hash requestHash,resource_id resourceId from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into p_outbox (id,created_at,updated_at,account_id,event_id,event_type,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,schema_version,trace_id,payload,status,next_run_at) values (#{id},#{now},#{now},#{accountId},#{eventId},'ACCESS_KEY_CHANGED','ACCESS_KEY',#{aggregateId},1,#{eventId},cast(#{payload} as json),'PENDING',#{now})
